name: Naukluft Hiking Trail (4-day section)
why: Four days across a dolomite plateau and down into deep kloofs, sleeping in stone shelters, with mountain zebra and no one else.
book: Book and pay with Namibia Wildlife Resorts at Naukluft (reservations@nwr.com.na). Groups of 3 to 12, open early March to end of October; a doctor's health certificate is required. The 4-day option ends at Tsams Ost: arrange the pick-up.
water: The overnight shelters have water. Fill 2 litres or more every morning: there is none on the way.
dangers: Long, rocky stretches with little shade: follow the trail markings on the rocks.
Hot days and cold nights on the plateau.
Steep descent into Ubusis Kloof and back out on day 3.
turnaround: Each day ends at a shelter; leave by 07:00 so you arrive before the afternoon heat. The way back from a shelter is the only exit.

points.name: Hiker's Haven, Naukluft
points.note: The hikers' cottage at Naukluft camp, used the night before. The path climbs south onto the plateau.

points.name: Putte Shelter
points.note: End of day 1, about 14 km, on the high plateau.

points.name: Ubusis Hikers Hut
points.note: End of day 2, a stone hut at the bottom of Ubusis Kloof. Day 3 climbs back out the same kloof.

points.name: Tsams Ost
points.note: End of the 4-day section, at the farm road where you are picked up.
